exposure: All preceding repo results and A12 pilot are known; this is not independent confirmation.
unit: patient LUAD-normal difference; repeated libraries pooled
coverage_basis: 12 paired patients satisfy both A12 recipient-state gates; triad overlap checked before defining the fit. Fixed single epithelial and fibroblast label; source broad aggregation is explicit and not the older A13 largest-single-macrophage rule.

response.interpretation: fixed lesion-associated RNA proxy, not lineage plasticity or repair capacity

fibroblast_predictor.interpretation: fibroblast TGF-beta-associated RNA programme, not active ligand or receptor engagement

score: mean log2(1+full-library CPM) in the exact state; LUAD-normal difference. This is a new A13 measurement, not a rerun of A11 TMM score.
primary_comparison: joint versus alternative, identical held-out patients
fit: reuse A12 train-only standardized leave-one-patient-out ridge; alpha=1 fixed; sensitivity alpha=.1/10, confidence=.3, cell_floor=30/100; never replace primary
precision: 12 pairs before scoring; small prediction pilot, no claim of sufficient power; overlapping CV losses are dependent and no p value or confidence interval is calculated
stop: less than ten complete patients, coverage below 70% of source list, missing source genes, count/metadata join inconsistency, or no outcome variation
decision: Report numerical gain and sensitivity stability; only independent validation can promote this exploratory conditional association. No causal feedback or transmission conclusion.
